Shopify Stores That Do Not Look Like Everyone Else

Shopify handles payments, inventory and hosting so you do not have to. What it cannot do is make your store look like your brand. That part is ours.

Get a Free Quote

The Platform Is Standard, the Storefront Should Not Be

Thousands of stores run the same handful of popular themes. Shoppers may not name the theme, but they recognise the layout — and it flattens your brand.

We design custom Shopify storefronts on top of the platform, so you keep the reliability of Shopify and lose the interchangeable look.

  • Custom themes built from your brand, not a preset
  • Sections your team can rearrange without a developer
  • Speed-conscious builds with disciplined app usage
  • Shopify Plus work where the scale demands it

Apps Are Convenient Until They Are Not

Every app adds scripts to your storefront. Ten of them, each solving a small problem, can collectively cost you a second or more of load time.

We audit what is installed, replace what can be built natively into the theme, and keep the rest from competing for the same page.

Process

How We Deliver

Kodex Designs believes in transparency every step of the way, keeping you in the loop with every executed plan.

Discovery

We get to know your brand, your goals, and the audience you intend to reach through conversations and discovery calls.

Strategy & Planning

We draft a tailored action plan with clear deliverables, timelines, KPIs, and the tools and platforms we will use.

Design & Build

Our team sets the plan in motion, and you are updated on progress at every stage of the build.

Launch & Support

We make every necessary retouch before launch. Only when you are satisfied do we go live — then we stay on for ongoing improvements.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a custom theme?

Not always. If a well-built theme is close to your needs, customising it is cheaper. We will tell you honestly which route fits your budget.

Can you work with Shopify Plus?

Yes, including checkout customisation, scripts and multi-store setups that Plus makes available.

Will my store still be fast?

That is part of the brief. We set a performance target, watch the app stack and test on mobile connections before launch.

Can you migrate my existing store to Shopify?

Yes. We handle product, customer and order migration plus the redirect mapping that keeps your search rankings intact.

Ready for a Shopify Store That Looks Like You?

Show us your catalogue and we will show you what we would do with it.
